The text serves as an analytical framework for interpreting discourses, sharing structural and hermeneutical relationships with other sections of the *Peṭakopadesa* (such as Pe 2, *Sāsanapaṭṭhānadutiyabhūmi*) and the *Nettippakaraṇa* (specifically Ne 37, *Sāsanapaṭṭhāna*).
